latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor Linux — browser-based AI-powered video editing for Linux users.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos (up to 500MB) and edit with natural language prompts.
- Automatic cloud-based editing: trim silences, add transitions, and export clean MP4 cuts.
- No software installation required; works on any Linux distro with Chrome or Firefox.
- Includes session management, credit system, and export/download workflow.
- Detailed error handling and direct mapping for common editing/task requests.
